description: 雷蒂开局 A07 — 开放线配合底行弱点

intro.popup_en:
Open Files and Back-Rank Weaknesses, Practice 9
White places a rook on e1 before the file opens. After e5 changes the structure, the rook can invade while Qh5 and Ng5 attack the kingside. Three pieces coordinate against the king and the vulnerable back rank.
intro.popup:
开放线+底行弱点 练习9

白方Re1守e线
e5推进后线路打通

Qh5+Ng5攻王翼
Re1配合穿透底行！

三子协同=最强攻势！

outro.popup_en: Summary: Re1 occupies the e-file in advance; after e5 opens the route, Re7 invades. Qh5, Ng5, and the rook work together. An active rook on an open file can exploit a back-rank weakness that the opponent cannot defend at the same time.
outro.popup:
底行弱点小结
✅ Re1提前占e线
✅ e5打通路线后Re7入侵
✅ Qh5+Ng5+Re1三方联动

顶级技巧：
开放线车+底行弱点
=对手无法同时防守！

moves.popup:
Nf3发展
雷蒂开局特色
moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops in the characteristic Réti Opening setup.
e4! A key advance that breaks the balance and prepares e5.
moves.popup:
e4！关键推进！
打破平衡，准备e5

moves.popup_en: Re1! White anticipates the position: after e5 advances, the e-file may open, and the rook is already in place.
moves.popup:
Re1！战略预判！
e5推进后e线将打开
车已提前就位！

moves.popup_en: e5! White advances, changing the central structure and preparing to open the e-file. Re1 is already posted there.
moves.popup:
e5！推进！
e线+d线结构大变！
Re1已就位！

moves.popup_en: Nf1! The knight maneuvers toward g3 and h5 to join the attack.
moves.popup:
Nf1！马机动！
准备Ng3→h5攻击路线

moves.popup_en: h4! White advances on the kingside and threatens h5, coordinating with the rook on e1.
moves.popup:
h4！王翼推进！
h5威胁黑王阵营
与Re1形成双线威胁

moves.popup_en: N1h2! The knight reroutes toward g4, with ideas such as Nf6 or Nxf7.
moves.popup:
N1h2！马转移！
准备Ng4-Nf6或Nxf7攻击

moves.popup_en: Ng5! The knight reaches g5 and directly threatens h7, coordinating with h4.
moves.popup:
Ng5！马踏g5！
直接威胁h7
与h4协同进攻！

moves.popup_en: Qh5! White's attack is fully coordinated. The queen threatens h7, Ng5 supports the kingside assault, and Re1 waits to invade on the e-file. Black's back rank is under severe pressure.
moves.popup:
Qh5！强力出击！
三子联动完成！

Qh5威胁h7
Ng5协同
Re1→Re7等待时机

黑方底行极度虚弱！
